findings.obligation: Failure look: after sign-in a failed reload must not leave the earlier warning/rights as current (list is pinned, connection page is not)
findings.observation: const reloadConnection = useCallback(async () => { const refreshed = await getConnectionSettings(); if (refreshed !== null) { setSelectedWorkTrackingSystem(refreshed); } }. On a null or rejected reload the old needsWriteConsent/grantedRights stay shown; the rejection is also unhandled because the hook calls onSignedIn?.() without await. No oracle row pins this on the connection page. Non-blocking, same pre-existing pattern as Reconnect.
findings.remediation: Oracle owner: add a page-level failed-reload scenario; implementation: clear needsWriteConsent/grantedRights (or show could-not-load) when the reload fails or returns null.

findings.observation: filter(... connection.requiresReconnect === true || connection.needsWriteConsent === true) renders ReconnectBanner and WriteConsentAlert in one Box; a connection that needs both shows two warnings, no test pins that combination. Low.
findings.remediation: Decide copy/order for the combined case or pin it; optional.
